title: DesktopPhase08ResultPayloadV1
description: The closed set of result payloads the Phase-08 operations return. No result carries a credential value, a token or its vault reference, or an absolute path of the user's computer.
$comment: ما يعبر: معرّفات وحالات ومسارات نسبية داخل المساحة ومقتطفات محدودة. لا سرّ ولا مسار مطلق.

WebSearchStatusResultV1.title: WebSearchStatusResultV1
WebSearchStatusResultV1.description: The chosen web search provider and whether it has what it needs. A key is reported as present or absent, never shown.

active.description: The host ranks memory by similarity now; a saved setting alone is not enough.

retrievals.description: Retrievals ranked with similarity since this host started.

failures.description: Retrievals that fell back to lexical ranking because embedding failed.

WebSearchTestResultV1.title: WebSearchTestResultV1
WebSearchTestResultV1.description: The outcome of one real test search, measured on the host.

TurnNoteV1.title: TurnNoteV1
TurnNoteV1.description: A message the user wrote while the mission ran. DELIVERED means the agent received it as a user message at delivered_at; NOT_DELIVERED means the mission ended first.

MissionGrantV1.title: MissionGrantV1
MissionGrantV1.description: One mission-scoped approval: this tool, this resource, these effects, in this mission, until expires_at. The gateway still evaluates policy on every call.

ToolApprovalGrantRevokeResultV1.title: ToolApprovalGrantRevokeResultV1
ToolApprovalGrantRevokeResultV1.description: How many grants were revoked now.

GitHubStatusResultV1.title: GitHubStatusResultV1
GitHubStatusResultV1.description: Whether a GitHub token is stored, and the account and scopes GitHub reported when it was checked. Never the token.

ConversationTurnV1.title: ConversationTurnV1
ConversationTurnV1.description: One user message and the mission that answered it. The message is shown as the user wrote it; answer is model output, displayed as data.

ConversationEntryV1.title: ConversationEntryV1
ConversationEntryV1.description: One line of a mission's live narration: the agent's words to the user (PLAN, NOTE), a step title (STEP), or a tool call with the status the gateway measured (ACTION).

ConversationIndexResultV1.title: ConversationIndexResultV1
ConversationIndexResultV1.description: Follow-up turns and the conversation each belongs to (the missions a task list shows inside their conversation instead of on their own), and the conversations the task menu changed (ADR-031).

SpecialistV1.title: SpecialistV1
SpecialistV1.description: A catalog specialist as the renderer shows it. Its working instructions stay in the host and reach only the model prompt. `agent` (remediation 2026-10-12) is the agent definition the host enforces when this specialist works: identity, version, tools, memory scope, budget and output contract.

AgentDefinitionViewV1.title: AgentDefinitionViewV1

real_model_acceptance.description: This build does not carry a real-model acceptance result for any agent; one is recorded only from a real model run the owner authorised.

AgentDefinitionViewV1.description: An agent definition as the host enforces it (remediation 2026-10-12, section 6).

ConversationThreadV1.title: ConversationThreadV1
ConversationThreadV1.description: A conversation as the task menu left it. A conversation without a record is not pinned, not a favourite and not archived.

ProviderCatalogResultV1.title: ProviderCatalogResultV1
ProviderCatalogResultV1.description: The provider catalog (ADR-037): built-in, catalogued from a dated models.dev snapshot, and custom. No credential, and no key status read from the store.

TraceSpanV1.title: TraceSpanV1
TraceSpanV1.description: ADR-041: one OpenTelemetry GenAI span (invoke_agent, chat, execute_tool). The field set is pinned by semconv because the specification is still Development.

spans.description: PHASE-10 (CP-10-1): one page, in start order.

next_after.description: The `after` value of the next page; null on the last page.

totals.description: Measured over every span of the mission, not the page. A finished model call that reported no tokens counts in unreported, never as zero.

otlp.description: OTLP/JSON ResourceSpans, only when include_otlp was asked.
